name: Summon Wand
pages: Right click to summon a golem on target block, from your off hand or inventory.$(br2)Shift right click to summon all golems from your inventory around you.

When L2Backpack is present:$(br2)This wand can also summon golems from Ender Backpack equipped.$(br2) If player has their own dimensional backpacks in inventory or ender backpack, this wand can also summon golems with same config color as the dimensional backpack those golems are in.
